Question 8

Find the integral of (2−1x)2 with respect to x.

(2x−ln⁡|x|)2+C
b
ln⁡|2−1x|+C
c
4x−4ln⁡|x|−1x+C
d
2x−ln⁡|x|+C
e
2xln⁡|x|+C
